inefficiencies.name: Spot BTC ETF creation/redemption and AP inventory pressure
inefficiencies.why_exists: Authorized participants and ETF issuers must create/redeem shares against underlying BTC (or cash-equivalent baskets). Large net creations force buy pressure in BTC spot/perp; redemptions force sell pressure. Flow is lumpy, predictable around NAV windows and settlement, not continuous free-float trading.
inefficiencies.who_creates: Authorized participants (APs), ETF issuers (IBIT, FBTC, GBTC, …), institutional allocators, market makers facilitating creations
inefficiencies.why_not_arbed_immediately: Creation/redemption has operational lag, AP capital and inventory constraints, primary-market hours, and risk of adverse selection around NAV. Secondary ETF price can diverge from NAV short-term; arb requires inventory and is capacity-limited. Post-2024 spot ETFs introduced a large new structural channel not present in pre-ETF free OHLCV history.
observables: daily net ETF flows (USD and BTC)
lagged flow aggregates (T+0 published often with lag)
inefficiencies.min_additional_data: Daily aggregate US spot BTC ETF net flows (BTC or USD) with documented publish lag for PIT; ideally multi-fund series since 2024-01-11
inefficiencies.notes: Highest joint score. Free delayed publishers exist (e.g. Farside-style daily tables, SoSoValue); paid APIs optional. Not a re-test of CMD exchange netflow.

inefficiencies.name: Options dealer gamma/hedging flows into spot/perp
inefficiencies.why_exists: Dealers short options to clients must delta-hedge; gamma near large expiries can force pro-cyclical buying/selling of BTC, creating temporary predictability around strikes and expiry dates.
inefficiencies.who_creates: Options dealers, market makers, leveraged options buyers/sellers
inefficiencies.why_not_arbed_immediately: Hedge flows are large and continuous near expiry; inventory and risk limits prevent full immediate offset; information about open interest is delayed/aggregated; capacity constraints for taking the other side.
inefficiencies.min_additional_data: Historical options OI / greeks or published dealer-gamma proxy with timestamps; Deribit-class history often paid or incomplete free
inefficiencies.notes: High EV but data costly and PIT hard; second to ETF for personal mandate.

inefficiencies.name: Forced liquidations and cascade selling/buying
inefficiencies.why_exists: Levered traders are liquidated mechanically when margin fails; cascades create temporary one-way flow and volatility spikes beyond voluntary trading.
inefficiencies.who_creates: Levered long/short traders, exchange liquidation engines
inefficiencies.why_not_arbed_immediately: Liquidations are forced and fast; liquidity voids; arbs face gap risk and exchange-specific queues. Aftershock mean-reversion may exist but is fragile.
inefficiencies.min_additional_data: If re-opening: vendor or free series with better PIT than CMD long-liq conf-null operationalisation; else do not re-mine same free series
inefficiencies.notes: Free CMD liquidations already conf-null as trade filters. Overlap high unless new operationalisation + better data.

inefficiencies.name: Stablecoin liquidity creation/transmission into BTC risk
inefficiencies.why_exists: USD on-ramps via USDT/USDC mint/burn change crypto system liquidity; expansions facilitate risk-on BTC buying, contractions force de-risking.
inefficiencies.who_creates: Tether/Circle issuers, exchanges, arbitrageurs, institutions parking cash in stables
inefficiencies.why_not_arbed_immediately: Mint/burn and bank-rail settlement lag; information about issuance is delayed; capacity and banking hours limit instant arb.
inefficiencies.min_additional_data: Daily USDT+USDC mint/burn or net issuance with publish lag
inefficiencies.notes: Stock growth characterised; creation process still missing. Distinct from CMD exchange netflow nulls.

inefficiencies.name: Institutional TWAP/VWAP and scheduled execution
inefficiencies.why_exists: Large institutions slice orders over time, creating autocorrelated flow and temporary price pressure during execution windows.
inefficiencies.who_creates: Funds, family offices, ETF secondary market makers, OTC desks
inefficiencies.why_not_arbed_immediately: Execution algos hide true size; detecting schedule requires microstructure or flow data; capacity limited.
inefficiencies.min_additional_data: Intraday multi-venue volume/order flow or institutional print data
inefficiencies.notes: Outside daily long/flat simplicity unless simplified proxy found.

inefficiencies.name: Miner treasury selling and hashprice stress
inefficiencies.why_exists: Miners sell BTC to cover USD opex; when hashprice falls, selling pressure rises, creating temporary supply shocks.
inefficiencies.why_not_arbed_immediately: Miner inventory opaque; sales OTC or delayed; hashprice public but stock of miner BTC is not.
inefficiencies.min_additional_data: Miner-to-exchange flow or miner balance series (often vendor)
inefficiencies.notes: Medium EV; free hashrate alone is weak without inventory.

inefficiencies.name: Corporate/sovereign treasury BTC accumulation
inefficiencies.why_exists: Treasury buyers (corporates, ETFs already covered separately) remove float on announced schedules, creating demand that is not pure speculative flow.
inefficiencies.why_not_arbed_immediately: Announcements and purchases are staggered; float reduction is slow; short-horizon arbs do not offset multi-day accumulation.
inefficiencies.min_additional_data: Event list of treasury purchases with as-of dates
inefficiencies.notes: Sparse events; hard for min_trades under daily gates.

inefficiencies.name: Exchange inventory / reserve constraints
inefficiencies.why_exists: When exchange balances fall, sell pressure may be scarce or withdrawals constrained; inventory shocks move prices.
inefficiencies.why_not_arbed_immediately: True reserves revision-prone; free netflow already conf-null; labels lag.
inefficiencies.min_additional_data: Vendor non-revised PIT reserves only if EIR still ranks above ETF free path
inefficiencies.notes: Free CMD netflow conf-null. Do not re-mine without vendor PIT justification after ETF path.

inefficiencies.name: Behavioural underreaction / slow information diffusion
inefficiencies.why_exists: Retail and some funds underreact to news; prices adjust over days.
inefficiencies.who_creates: Retail traders, discretionary funds, media consumers
inefficiencies.why_not_arbed_immediately: In efficient markets TSMOM should be competed away; in crypto residual underreaction may remain but public long/flat ops exhausted.
inefficiencies.min_additional_data: None for classic TSMOM — but family exhausted on free public ops
inefficiencies.notes: Do not reopen without new information channel (not another SMA).

inefficiencies.name: Macro and regulatory information transmission
inefficiencies.why_exists: Policy and macro surprises reprice risk assets with lag as crypto participants learn and reposition.
inefficiencies.who_creates: Central banks, regulators, global risk-off capital
inefficiencies.why_not_arbed_immediately: Interpretation lag; weekend/crypto-native participants; FRED already null as atomistic filters.
inefficiencies.min_additional_data: Event surprise residuals or better event calendar if reopening
inefficiencies.notes: Free FRED atomistic programme null. Revisit only as event-surprise design.
